where: Saltreach Fen I (the open reed marsh east of Pearlmoor)
mood: A slow drift through reed shallows — a breathy woodwind wanders and the lapping water answers; melancholy, never sad.
core_styles: breathy wooden flute lead with long held notes and soft turns
slow rocking two-note harp figure like lapping water
gentle rocking round synth bass on root and fifth
very sparse brushed hat on the offbeats and one soft low tap per bar
cosy-melancholy marsh wandering theme, lanterns floating on dark water
call and response between melody and water

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {the reeds part: the rocking water figure starts alone on harp, then the flute calls a rising three-note phrase over the mist and holds, inviting you into the marsh}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the flute sings the wandering melody, long notes that rise hopefully then settle home a step too slowly; between phrases it leaves gaps and the harp water-figure answers}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again with a soft bell counter-line answering in the rests, string pad a little fuller, the bass rocking gently}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a warmer turn to F major, lanterns drifting on the water, the flute rises higher in longer arching phrases over sustained strings, then sinks back toward D minor}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the wandering melody returns as at first; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
